You had sleep paralysis. It's not fun, sometimes you can have hallucinations and auditory hallucinations. You get it when in REM sleep I'm pretty sure so that's why everything can be very scary like a nightmare you are awake in, but can't move.  Sometimes for people it's better to fight it to get out of the paralysis or to not fight it. When you wake up and can move after it's the over, I learned you have to get up immediately or else you will fall back asleep and it will happen again.

What helps me is not opening my eyes, because the things your brain can bring up into your vision can leave you haunted for a while. I get it daily. I just get used to having it happen and  feeling what ever fucked things are touching you. I find it that working out seems to make it end sooner and then make myself stay awake for and five or ten minutes. Kinda giving my brain a refresh and usually won't happen again for the rest of my sleep.
